summary: Interparfums, Inc. filed an 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 disclosing an exclusive worldwide license agreement with PUMA to create, develop, produce, and distribute PUMA-branded fragrances. The license runs through December 31, 2037, with a new signature lifestyle fragrance planned for 2027. No financial terms, stake, price per share, premium, or board recommendation were disclosed. The filing is a routine commercial licensing arrangement, not a special-situation transaction; it includes the September 22, 2026 press release as Exhibit 99.1. Watch for launch timing and revenue contribution, not risk-arb.
